description: One call: create a curated kids' Christmas gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call (or give only ageBand/interests to auto-fill curated picks). Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (amazon.se default). Returns id, editToken, shopUrl, ownerUrl, parentUrl, kidUrl. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

count.description: If no items are given, auto-fill this many curated picks for the age band/interests (default 6)

country.description: ISO country of the shopper, e.g. US or SE (used when marketplace is omitted)

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a wish

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en-US, sv, de. en-US switches to amazon.com when marketplace is omitted.

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (US) or amazon.se (Sweden, default); also uk, de, fr… Order: marketplace → country → locale/Accept-Language (en-US ⇒ amazon.com) → amazon.se. amazon.se returns curated /dp product links; amazon.com returns English search links tagged for amazon.com.

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill
